name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Pentagon revokes security clearance of former Air Force chief
changes.summary: The Pentagon alleged that former U.S. Air Force Secretary Frank Kendall disclosed sensitive information about Air Force One's capabilities to the media.

changes.title: Their African Islands Were Set to Be Decolonized. Then the U.S. Bombed Iran.
changes.summary: The inhabitants of the Chagos Islands were expelled by the British 60 years ago. Refugees were anxious to return this year, but their hopes have been caught in a morass of geopolitics.

changes.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general after weeks of uncertainty
changes.summary: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as U.S. attorney general early Saturday in a mostly party-line vote, capping off weeks of uncertainty and despite bipartisan concerns about his ability to run a Justice Department independent of President Donald Trump’s impulses.

changes.title: Pentagon revokes security clearance of former Air Force chief for disclosing "classified information regarding Air Force One's capabilities"

changes.title: Employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs in a sign of a wilting labor market
changes.summary: U.S. employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, and job gains for the two previous months were weaker than initially reported, according to a report Friday from the Labor Department. (Image credit: Joe Raedle).

changes.title: Iranians Say Trump’s Promises Have Fallen by the Wayside as Iran War Drags On
changes.summary: As President Trump struggles to extricate the United States from the war in Iran, his promises to protesters in the country have fallen by the wayside.

changes.title: Family of Former U.S. Marine Detained in Russia Says He Is in Serious Condition
changes.summary: Robert Gilman, 32, is in “dissociative stupor,” an advocacy group said, and his family members say they are afraid for his life. Mr. Gilman was arrested in Russia in 2022.

changes.title: U.S. loses jobs while unemployment rate drops
changes.summary: A jobs report came in weaker than expected as stocks hit a record high. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

changes.title: Blanche on track for narrow Senate confirmation as attorney general
changes.summary: At the U.S. Capitol, it was a wild day of decision and indecision. The Senate passed the toughest sanctions bill on Russia yet and is also now on track to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general. But a slew of other high-priority items are still tangled, largely due to a Republican divide. Congressional correspondent.
